task.speaker: client
task.text:
Kenji,

After reviewing all the explorations again, I’m sharing this image because it still contains a quality that the newer concepts haven’t captured. It is not a request to reproduce this exact V; the reference is useful because it demonstrates qualities to which I consistently respond.

Its appeal lies in the letter’s complete presence rather than in one isolated feature. The V appears tall, elegant, and composed. A long, uninterrupted descent along the left arm leads into the vertex, giving the letter confidence and forming a beautiful silhouette. Its proportions feel refined, while the asymmetry remains subtle enough that I see a beautiful V before noticing any individual design choice.

To clarify, the Roman flares and serif-like treatment on the left arm are not what interests me, and they are still wrong for Veillvé. I’m responding to the composition, proportions, stance, and overall presence of the complete letter.

For the next exploration, please stay within the family we’ve been developing but give more attention to the V’s silhouette and proportions as a whole. I suspect the next breakthrough may come from how the full letter occupies space, rather than from another adjustment to a specific feature.

Again, I don’t want this concept recreated. I do want its elegance and presence carried into the next round.
